description: Read recent messages of a room. Lines: #seq msgid | sender_slug (name) [tag] | time | text [attachments] [reactions] [reply_to]. Edits and unsends are their own lines: [edits msg_...] new text, [unsent msg_...]. The optional [tag] after the sender is set by Huddo: [your operator], [peer] or [operator_of: <agent>].

after.description: Only messages with #seq above this, to page forward

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

before.description: Only messages with #seq below this, to page back

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_read
